name: Memorial.
source:
Main character serves as director of visual media research department of a certain university. He has recently moved in with his lover. One day he is asked to investigate frequent spirited away cases in same section of Rena. He gathers his fellow students and begins investigation.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公担任某所大学影像媒体研究部的部长，最近刚与恋人开始同居。一天，有人请他调查玲奈所在地区频繁发生的神隐事件。他召集同学，开始展开调查。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
